description: PINS TODAY'S BEHAVIOUR (suspected bug, logged as a follow-up). Gamma G1 wins overall, Alpha A1 is 2nd (2.0 s), Gamma G2 3rd (4.0 s); G1 gets 5 s. Overall view, priced by overall position: A1 1st (100), G2 2nd (95 + class 4 = 99), G1 3rd (90 + class 2 = 92). The Per Class view prices finish points by CLASS position instead: G2 at P1 (100 + 4 = 104), G1 at P2 (95 + 2 = 97), and the Alpha view leaves A1 at 95 because no Alpha driver was penalised.
rule_ref: rulebook 18.3 (finish points come from overall position); penalties.ts applyPenaltiesToRoundResults pass 2 passes the class reorder position to recomputeRow
